# V0.10.12

Section: Source

**V0.10.12** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on march 27th, 2020.

## V0.10.12

- Feature - Winches v2 (Now use rope logic)

- Fix - Rope buoyancy
- Fix - Clients on dedicated servers always seeing delete mission button
- Fix - Blank chat message CTD
- Fix - Daylight ticking while game is paused
